profile.positioning: Isabela Martins is the Founder & CEO of Evergreen Home, a curated online marketplace connecting consumers with ethically sourced and sustainable home goods. Having previously scaled and successfully exited TerraBloom, a subscription box service for artisan products, Isabela is uniquely positioned to identify and nurture emerging brands with strong sustainability narratives. Evergreen Home is focused on solving the discoverability challenges faced by eco-conscious businesses, providing them with a platform to reach a wider audience. Currently focused on securing seed funding and expanding our brand partnerships, I’m seeking connections with investors passionate about the sustainable consumer space, and brands aligning with our ethos. I’m also open to mentorship opportunities for early-stage e-commerce founders.

Led the implementation of a new CRM system, improving customer segmentation and targeted marketing efforts.
• **Digital Marketing Specialist, Bloom & Branch** (2015 – 2016): Focused on SEO, SEM, and social media marketing for a direct-to-consumer floral delivery service. Increased organic traffic by 35% through keyword research and content optimization. Managed social media channels, growing follower base by 50% in six months.
